component: Compose OS progress bridge and object lifetime

quotes.text: // Once we have this object, we must hold a reference to it until the window

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current TaskbarProgress helper acquires a Windows receiver for docShell, a macOS dock service or a GTK instance bound to the window, returning null when unsupported. Compose keeps the receiver in a lazy binding until the window closes; its source comment names a Windows lifetime constraint. Terminal progress is separately signaled, so the current mock test waits progress stop as well as window closure. These are later accepted refinements beyond the original facade. No native OS or send test ran.
title: Compose taskbar progress acquires a platform receiver and retains it for the window
